mapper.select: SELECT db_seq AS "dbSeq" , db_name AS "dbName" , env_label AS "envLabel" , jdbc_url AS "jdbcUrl" , username AS "username" , password_enc AS "passwordEnc" , schema_name AS "schemaName" , sort_order AS "sortOrder" , to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt" FROM analysis_project_db WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY sort_order, db_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_project_db (project_id, db_seq, db_name, env_label, jdbc_url, username, password_enc, schema_name, sort_order) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{dbSeq}, #{dbName}, #{envLabel}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc}, #{schemaName}, #{sortOrder})
